mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 4.5% over the past 3 months signals monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS remains above 4.5% for 3 months or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test), this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% over the past 3 months signals monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS remains below 4.5% for 3 months or 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test), this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 3.5% over the past 3 months signals a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE does not rise above 3.5% or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test), this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of FEDFUNDS below 4.5% and elevated GDPC1 (quarterly demand) signals monetary easing and robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If either FEDFUNDS is not below 4.5% or GDPC1 is not above 22506, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test), this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: High CPIAUCSL and elevated GDPC1 during a late-cycle expansion signal overheating, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the macro regime is not late-cycle expansion or the combination of CPIAUCSL > 307.9 and GDPC1 > 22506 does not occur, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test), this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in PAYEMS above 157087 (current value) signals a robust labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS does not exceed 157087 or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test), this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in INDPRO above 102.6651 signals robust supply, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO does not rise above 102.6651 or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test), this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of INDPRO above 102.6651 and RSAFS below 705692 signals supply-demand imbalance, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If either INDPRO is not above 102.6651 or RSAFS is not below 705692, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test), this hypothesis is rejected.
